faqs.q: How do I know if my ducts need repair?
faqs.a: Signs include high energy bills, uneven temperatures, unusual noises, or visible damage to ductwork.

faqs.q: How long does duct repair take?
faqs.a: Most residential repairs are completed in a single visit, typically 2 to 4 hours.

faqs.q: Do you repair both flexible and rigid ducts?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all duct types including flexible, sheet metal, and fiberboard systems.

faqs.q: Will you need to open walls or ceilings?
faqs.a: Most repairs are done through access panels or existing openings — wall access is rare and always discussed beforehand.

heroSubtitle: Fix Damaged, Crushed & Leaking Dryer Vents Safely & Fast.
introP1: A damaged dryer vent is more than an inconvenience — it's a safety hazard. Crushed, disconnected, or leaking vents trap heat and moisture inside your walls, increase fire risk, and force your dryer to work harder with every cycle.
introP2: HD Pro Cleaning's technicians diagnose and repair all types of dryer vent damage quickly and thoroughly. Whether it's a crushed section of duct, a disconnected joint, or a damaged exterior cap, we restore safe, efficient venting.

galleryItems.title: Crushed Duct Repair
galleryItems.desc: Crushed or kinked dryer duct sections are replaced to restore full, unrestricted airflow.

galleryItems.title: Disconnected Joint Repair
galleryItems.desc: Separated duct connections are rejoined, secured, and sealed against air and lint leakage.

galleryItems.title: Leaking Duct Sealing
galleryItems.desc: Leaking joints and seams are sealed to prevent moisture and lint from escaping into wall cavities.

galleryItems.title: Exterior Cap Repair
galleryItems.desc: Damaged or missing exterior vent caps are replaced to prevent pest entry and weather damage.

galleryItems.title: Code Compliance Repair
galleryItems.desc: Non-compliant vent materials (plastic or foil) are replaced with metal duct to meet safety codes.

galleryItems.title: Commercial Vent Repair
galleryItems.desc: Dryer vent repairs for laundromats, apartment buildings, and commercial laundry facilities.

benefits.title: Fire Safety

benefits.title: Mold Prevention

benefits.title: Faster Drying

benefits.title: Lower Energy Bills

whyDesc: We repair dryer vents right the first time — using code-compliant materials, proper sealing, and post-repair airflow testing for your safety.

faqs.q: How do I know my dryer vent needs repair?
faqs.a: Signs include clothes not drying, the dryer overheating, a burning smell, or visible damage to vent sections.

faqs.q: Can you repair plastic or foil dryer vents?
faqs.a: We replace them. Plastic and foil vents are fire hazards — we upgrade to code-compliant metal duct.

faqs.q: How long does a repair take?
faqs.a: Most repairs are completed in 1 to 2 hours. Complex repairs involving wall access may take longer.

faqs.q: Do you repair commercial dryer vents?
faqs.a: Yes. We service laundromats, apartment laundry rooms, and commercial laundry facilities.
